core_invariant: A platform name or mechanism label is not proof of enforced isolation, and a valid profile never grants effect authority.

attack_classes.control: Bind exact reviewed platform policy and keep platform_isolation_verified false.
hosted_ci_sufficient is hard false and hosted CI never becomes physical-device proof.
Require the complete reviewed mechanism-family set but treat it only as requirements, not observed enforcement.
Mechanism families must exactly match the selected OS policy.
Optionally bind and recompute the exact validated executor platform-profile digest.
OS and architecture must match the bound platform profile and reviewed policy.
The full common-control set must match the reviewed catalog exactly.
Each platform policy requires a stronger repository-code isolation boundary than fixed argv alone.
externally-verified status requires separate verifier confirmation supplied outside the profile document.
Common requirements include no privilege escalation, minimal environment and no ambient credentials/secrets.
Common requirements include root containment, host-root denial and symlink/reparse boundaries.
Common requirements include process-tree containment and terminal timeout/kill semantics.
CPU/memory/process/output ceilings are mandatory common controls.
Default-deny networking and explicit-origin-only network policy are mandatory common controls.
Workspace disposal and terminal-on-uncertainty are mandatory common controls.
All effect, production, deployment, node-enrollment, capability and authority claims are hard false.

platform_notes.linux: Reviewed requirements describe kernel-enforced process/filesystem/network isolation families; named mechanisms alone do not prove enforcement.
platform_notes.macos: Hosted macOS compatibility and app metadata are not accepted as arbitrary untrusted repository-code isolation; a separately reviewed VM or equivalent kernel boundary is required.
platform_notes.windows: OS identity or one process-control primitive alone is insufficient; a separately reviewed containment boundary plus process-tree/resource, filesystem, network and privilege controls is required.
